text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined I would suffer such an 
injury... I am terribly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I caused you so much trouble, Trainer... 
I feel truly pathetic..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I'm sorry. It's only causing you 
more trouble if I just keep moping around, 
right...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Mm. If it's just this much... I should 
be able to resume training.
choice_data_list:
Let's hold off on resuming until you're 
fully healed.

Let's think about what we can do right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I will do my best without 
overexerting myself so that I can recover 
quickly.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
First, let's start with a nutritious 
meal... Would you care to join me, if 
you'd like...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...! Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I promise I won't do anything reckless...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Mmh, mmh...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... It's just... it seems I put too 
much pressure on the injured area...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Continuing any further... might only 
make things worse."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Thank you very much... ...It's a 
shame, but I think I'll stop here for 
today...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Deciding that she couldn't afford to let 
it worsen any further, Still in Love chose 
to take a period of rest...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Thank you very much... If it's 
within my power, I'll do anything...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Phew... pheeew...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Thank goodness. It seems the injury 
wasn't as bad as we thought.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I won't let my guard down, so please 
rest easy. ...Besides,

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Since you are keeping watch over me, 
Trainer, I have nothing to worry about... 
Fufu.
